source_snapshot.items: Check BMC Dimm usage rate under idle
source_snapshot.procedure: Boot the BMC console and run `top | grep -i redfish` with the system idle for 12 hours.
source_snapshot.criteria: DIMM usage is smooth with no abnormal increases or decreases.
source_snapshot.script: Stress bundle; 10 attended and 720 machine minutes; unique code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes insecure one-shot top/free/meminfo output that cannot represent a 12-hour trend.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/LOW; retained Pending for memory metric, idle definition, interval, gap and trend/high-water limits.

old_problem: Neither 'DIMM usage' nor 'smooth/abnormal' is quantitatively defined. A one-time filtered top line loses the required 12-hour behavior and cannot separate Redfish process growth, restart, cache movement or total BMC memory pressure.
disposition_reason: Pending remains because ED-15 forbids PASS without an approved threshold, and generic Linux documentation cannot supply a product-specific allowable Redfish RSS slope, BMC available-memory floor or restart/gap budget. The test method is otherwise complete and parameterized: define verified idle, process identity and approved metrics/limits, collect an uninterrupted 12-hour time series, correlate service health, and preserve raw evidence.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2092, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2093 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00017-V003 / 6f226a8d69ea8353 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Linux top/free/proc expose measurements but do not define acceptable product memory growth; thresholds must come from BMC/project performance authority.
Twelve hours is mandatory and cannot be replaced by a smoke sample; sampling must cover the full interval on a monotonic time basis with an approved maximum gap.
Track MemTotal/MemAvailable and all Redfish service PIDs with start time, RSS, PSS or approved equivalent, VMS, threads and command identity so restarts cannot masquerade as recovery.
Verified idle must exclude management requests, update jobs and other scheduled workload beyond an approved background baseline.
Correlate every discontinuity with Redfish/service/journal/SEL/BMC health; retain collection errors and never smooth across process identities.
Use authenticated access without embedded credentials or host-key bypass, avoid excessive collector load, preserve logs and stop on management degradation.
No BMC login, process query, 12-hour collection, service restart, recovery, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Twelve-hour BMC total and Redfish-service memory stability — LIMITS PENDING
test_case.purpose: Measure whether approved total-BMC and Redfish-service memory metrics remain within authoritative stability bounds throughout a verified 12-hour idle period without service or management degradation.
required_package: BMC owner-approved metric set, RSS/PSS handling and process identity rule
Verified idle-state definition and permitted background jobs
Sampling interval, maximum gap, slope/delta/high-water and available-memory limits
Authenticated BMC shell or supported telemetry API with secure storage/time synchronization
BMC service/journal/SEL health access and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: DO NOT START the verdict-bearing run until metrics and numeric limits are approved. Then securely inventory BMC version, uptime, time basis and all Redfish process identities; prove the approved idle state; collect timestamped MemTotal/MemAvailable plus complete per-process start-time/RSS/PSS-or-approved/VMS/thread/command data at the approved cadence for the full 12 hours. Preserve raw samples and collector errors, compute coverage/gaps, slopes, deltas and high-water values per process lifecycle, and correlate service/journal/SEL/health events. Do not clear logs, truncate with `head`, expose passwords or bypass host verification.
test_case.expected_result: Cannot be numerically finalized until owner limits are supplied. The full 12-hour series must meet every approved total-memory and per-process bound, stay above the memory-availability floor, contain no excessive gaps or unexplained restarts, and show no Redfish/BMC degradation.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS without signed metric, idle, interval, gap and numeric stability limits. After unlock, PASS requires complete coverage and every approved delta/slope/high-water/floor/restart condition within bounds with healthy services. FAIL on exceeded limit, leak-like growth, memory exhaustion, unapproved restart, collection gap beyond budget or management degradation; evidence/access loss is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until numeric trend/high-water/floor/gap criteria and idle definition are approved.
Use authenticated read-only collection and bound its CPU/storage impact.
Do not clear BMC logs or conceal PID restarts/discontinuities.
Stop and preserve evidence on BMC access loss, service failure, memory exhaustion or collector-induced impact.
expected_evidence: Exact source identity/hash plus signed idle/metric/interval/limit contract
BMC firmware, uptime, time basis and complete Redfish process identity/start-time baseline
Checksummed raw 12-hour total/free/available and per-process sample series
Expected versus received sample count, gap report and collector-resource footprint
Per-lifecycle start/end/delta/slope/window/high-water calculations without smoothing restarts
Redfish/service/journal/SEL/BMC-health correlation, recovery status and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On access loss, service failure, critical memory pressure or collector impact, stop collection and preserve its raw partial series plus logs. Do not restart services or BMC automatically; follow the approved recovery and retain the run as incomplete rather than retrying silently.

source_conflict.reason: The one-shot/insecure evidence defects are removed, but the source still lacks authoritative definitions and numeric limits for 'smooth' and 'abnormal'.

blocked.reason: A complete observation method exists; execution awaits a supplyable product acceptance contract rather than an unknown test identity.

pending.unlock_condition: A signed project acceptance contract defines the exact memory metrics, verified idle state, cadence/gap allowance and numeric stability/high-water/availability/restart limits; then re-review.

external_authorities.application: Preserves the formal 12-hour duration and evidence while prohibiting an unapproved threshold or insecure shortcut.
